subject: Finvest request: Hosted API penetration test & secure delivery options
messages:
From: Sophie Reynolds <sreynolds@finvest.com>
To: jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Cc: sec@finvest.com
Date: Tue, 05 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: latest penetration test for Hosted API + secure transfer

Hi Jordan,

We're preparing documents for our vendor security review (SIG + CAIQ) and need the most recent penetration test report that covers Redwood's Hosted API surface (token handling, request/response logging, KV/prefix caching, and public endpoints). Specifically: scope, test date, high/critical findings, and any remediation notes.

What is the recommended/available way for FinVest to receive the report securely? Our procurement/security team requires either an encrypted artifact via SFTP/presigned link or access to a secure evidence portal. If you have an NDA template or sharing instructions, please include.

Use case: procurement approval for production integration (we will not circulate internally beyond the security & procurement reviewers).

Thanks,
Sophie Reynolds
Security Program Manager
FinVest Capital
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0198

--

Date: Tue, 05 May 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: latest penetration test for Hosted API + secure transfer

Hi Sophie — thanks for the note and the context. We can provide the penetration test materials for the Hosted API. A few quick questions so we match your requirements:

- Do you require the full report or is an executive summary + findings sufficient for procurement?
- Do you prefer a presigned S3 link to a password-protected/encrypted ZIP, SFTP drop (we can whitelist an IP), or access via our secure evidence portal (requires NDAs/portal account)?
- If NDAs are needed, do you have a standard one or should we send ours?

Options we typically offer:
- Encrypted ZIP (AES-256) + presigned S3 link (expires configurable, we suggest 7 days) + password shared out-of-band
- SFTP drop to your host with temporary creds and IP allowlist
- Portal access (we provision temporary viewer accounts after NDA)

CC'ing Aditya (security) and Marissa (CS) to confirm attachments and any redaction requirements. If you can confirm preferred method and whether the full report is required, we'll prepare the package and next steps.

Best,
Jordan Blake

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: jordan_blake@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 05 May 2026 11:50:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: FinVest - pentest share approach (need security sign-off)

Jordan / Marissa — security here. Recommended approach:

1) We can provide: exec summary (PDF) + full report packaged into a password-protected ZIP (AES-256). We redact internal debugging keys, customer-identifying test artifacts, and any vendor-supplied exploit POCs that would enable re-run. No redaction to vulnerability descriptions, remediation status, or timelines.
2) Delivery: presigned S3 link that expires in 7 days (default) + password shared out-of-band (phone or different email address). Alternatively SFTP if FinVest prefers.
3) We require an NDA before releasing the full report. Exec summary can be shared ahead of NDA if procurement needs it immediately.

Attachments we will produce:
- redwood_hostedapi_pentest_2025_exec_summary.pdf
- redwood_hostedapi_pentest_2025_full_report_encrypted.zip
- redwood_pt_readme.txt (describes redaction list and CVE mapping)

Operational notes: I will generate the encrypted package and notify infra to create the presigned URL when we have confirmation from procurement/NDA status. Password will be provided in a separate message (or we can call Sophie's security contact).

-Aditya
Principal Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai

Hi Sophie — per our security team's recommendation, we can proceed one of two ways depending on your preference:

A) Fast route (no NDA required up-front):
- We share the executive summary (PDF) immediately via email.
- If you confirm this is sufficient for procurement, we stop here.

B) Full report (standard):
- We will deliver the full penetration test report as an AES-256 password-protected ZIP. The ZIP + exec summary will be uploaded to a presigned S3 link that expires in 7 days.
- We will require a signed NDA before we attach/send the full report. Exec summary can be released ahead of NDA.

If you confirm route B, please either: 1) confirm you will sign our NDA (I can send it), or 2) share your NDA and we'll route to Legal. Also let us know if you prefer SFTP instead of presigned S3.

Proposed filenames (for reference):
- redwood_hostedapi_pentest_2025_exec_summary.pdf
- redwood_hostedapi_pentest_2025_full_report_encrypted.zip
- redwood_pt_readme.txt

If you'd like the presigned link, we will: generate the encrypted package, create a presigned URL (7-day expiry), and send the password via phone or separate email to your security contact.

Would you like us to send the exec summary now so procurement can keep moving?

Best,
